GitGallery keeps your photo library in a private GitHub repository you own.

## New

- **Web gallery** at https://gitgallery-umber.vercel.app. Sign in with GitHub, browse the same library, and upload photos and videos from a browser.
- **Cloud videos play** in the app, including large ones stored as release assets.
- **Videos back up** with "Sync all" and auto-sync, not only when picked by hand.
- **Interrupted uploads resume** the next time the app opens.
- **Upload progress** shows the file being sent and moves during batched commits.

## Fixed

- After swiping in the viewer, Favourite, Download and Delete acted on the photo first opened, not the one on screen.
- A photo downloaded from the library was uploaded again as a duplicate.
- Downloading a large video saved a small pointer file instead of the video.
- Panoramas were shrunk to 2048 px on the long side; they now keep the pixel count of a 2:1 photo.
- Videos were labelled `video/mp4` whatever their format.
- A stalled request could hold a sync at 0/N forever; every request now has a deadline.
- Files with no capture date were identified by name alone, so two different files with the same name could be mistaken for each other.
- The iOS app launches when built with Xcode 27 (UIScene life cycle).
- Logout now asks for confirmation.

## Install

- **Android:** `GitGallery-1.1.0-release.apk`. It is signed with the project's debug key, so Android warns before installing; it installs over 1.0.0.
- **iOS:** `GitGallery-1.1.0-unsigned.ipa` is unsigned. Re-sign it with your own Apple ID (for example Sideloadly or AltStore) to install it.
